mapper.insert: INSERT INTO permission (PERMISSION_NAME, PERMISSION_CODE, PERMISSION_TYPE, PERMISSION_URL, LEVEL, PARENT_ID, CREATE_TIME, IS_DELETE) VALUES (#{permissionName}, #{permissionCode}, #{permissionType}, #{permissionUrl}, #{level}, #{parentId}, #{createTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.update: UPDATE permission SET IS_DELETE=0 WHERE PERMISSION_ID=#{permissionId}

update.foreach: UPDATE permission SET IS_DELETE=0 WHERE PERMISSION_ID=#{item}

mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM permission
IS_DELETE=1 AND PERMISSION_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{permissionName},'%') AND PERMISSION_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{permissionCode},'%') AND PERMISSION_TYPE=#{permissionType}
SELECT p.* FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.PERMISSION_ID = rp.PERMISSION_ID WHERE rp.ROLE_ID = #{roleId} AND p.IS_DELETE=1 AND rp.IS_DELETE=1

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.PERMISSION_ID = rp.PERMISSION_ID INNER JOIN user_role ur ON rp.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.PERMISSION_TYPE = 1 AND p.IS_DELETE = 1 AND rp.IS_DELETE = 1 AND ur.IS_DELETE = 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.PERMISSION_CODE FROM permission p INNER JOIN role_permission rp ON p.PERMISSION_ID = rp.PERMISSION_ID INNER JOIN user_role ur ON rp.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID = #{userId} AND p.PERMISSION_TYPE = 2 AND p.IS_DELETE = 1 AND rp.IS_DELETE = 1 AND ur.IS_DELETE = 1
